text:
maya: Quick sync: proposing a 'quarantine activation' for risky runtime config commits. idea: a short, isolated activation window where affected routes get soft-cap quotas and canary-only traffic before full rollout.

owen: can you sketch the semantics?

maya: sure. workflow: 
1) POST /configs/commit with {commit_id, activation: {mode: "quarantine", duration_mins: 30, quota_mult: 0.2, cohorts: ["beta"]}}
2) system applies config but marks routes as quarantined; routing layer enforces quota_mult for those routes and redirects overflow to fallback model/variant.

samir: so the routes are active but limited. good. how do we measure regressions during quarantine?

maya: quarantine emits a per-route telemetry bundle: p99/p95, errors, tokens, and quota-truncation rate. we keep baseline window and quarantine_deltas. we also produce a compact pass/fail token.

elaine: we need UI hooks: timeline with live telemetry + a button to 'promote' or 'rollback' when window ends. product also wants an automatic backoff if errors spike.

maya: default auto-backoff thresholds: p95 delta > 10ms OR error_rate_delta > 0.5% OR quota_truncation > 1%. any breach pauses promotion and sends alert to @oncall.

owen: privacy note: telemetry must drop request bodies and only surface route identifiers. we should support redaction levels in the commit payload.

maya: agreed. commit supports redaction: none|mask|anonymize. default=mask.

samir: what about quotas interplay? some leases artificially bump quota during quarantine to avoid immediate throttles, but that hides regressions. i prefer quota_mult <1 to force conservative behavior.

elaine: ops: can we allow an escape hatch? emergency promotion or immediate rollback with audit comment. also tie into config-ledger and tickets.

maya: yes: POST /configs/action with {preview_id|commit_id, action: "promote"|"rollback", reason: string}. we append immutable ledger event with actor, ts, git_sha.

console-bot: checklist: add RBAC scopes (configs.commit.quarantine, configs.action), add telemetry schema (quarantine_bundle_v1), add console buttons + websocket for live updates.

owen: implementational nit: make commit_id stable and return a quarantine_instance_id (uuid) so retries don't spawn parallel quarantines. idempotency is key.

maya: good point. quarantine_instance_id = HMAC(commit_id + seed + operator_id).

samir: SLIs: also add cost delta per 1k tokens. some routing changes silently increase CPU / token cost. console wants a red/yellow/green indicator calculated server-side.

maya: we'll return {score: 0-100, raw_metrics: {...}, suggested_action: "promote|hold|rollback"}. UI can surface recommended action and link to raw telemetry.

elaine: there's an edge case: multi-route commits where some routes are fine and others fail. policy: quarantine operates per-route; we can promote pass routes automatically after operator opt-in, or require manual per-route promotion. product prefers per-route promote controls.

maya: implement per-route granularity. the default is manual when any route fails, but orgs can enable auto-split-promote.

samir: testing: need an infra e2e harness that can simulate traffic and inject errors to validate auto-backoff logic. can we reuse the chaos harness?

maya: yes, reuse chaos-runner + a small scripted workload. i'll write a lightweight smoke test and add to PR.

owen: timeline?

maya: RFC today, small API + telemetry PoC early next week, console wiring after.

elaine: +1. ping me when RFC is ready; i'll coordinate product + support.

maya: thanks all. creating RFC now. :white_check_mark:
